content: AI requests are paused until {{date}}. Contact the Full admin to raise the limit.

comment.text: Description under the AI spending limit notice, shown to regular users who cannot change limits; {{date}} is the localized date when the limit resets. Full admin is the administrator role name.

usage.context:
<ServiceLimitNotice
 title={t("Common:AILimitReached")}
 description={
 isAdmin
 ? t("Common:AILimitReachedResetsOn", { date })
 : t("Common:AILimitReachedContactAdminResetsOn", { date })
 }
 buttonLabel={t("Common:ChangeAILimit")}
 onClick={isAdmin ? openLimits : undefined}
 />
 );
